alt: The Vitay login page with the Email and Password fields, the Sign in button and the Sign in with SSO button
The Account Security tab with the Multi-factor authentication and Multi-factor Google authentication switches beside the password form
needs: recruiter has a phone number saved so the Multi-factor authentication switch is enabled; firm does not force MFA

alt: The Vitay Overview dashboard with the left sidebar and the top bar
needs: demo firm with some candidates and completed references so the dashboard is populated; is_demo_enabled off so no demo banner

alt: The Users page in Configuration listing users with their role badges
needs: at least one root recruiter, one supervisor and one plain recruiter in the firm

alt: The top-bar company pill opened to show the Switch account menu, with the current firm ticked
needs: user with access to 2+ firms (parent root recruiter with sub-accounts)

alt: A candidate page with the yellow different-branch banner above the candidate header
needs: parent root recruiter browsing the parent firm; :candidateId belongs to a sub-account, not the current firm

alt: The Account page Information tab with the Language card and the personal details form
needs: recruiter with first name, last name and phone filled in

alt: The Account Security tab with the password form on the left and the MFA switches on the right
needs: recruiter has a phone number saved

alt: The Cookie preferences dialog with the four categories and one category's cookie table expanded
needs: fresh browser context with no consent cookie so the banner shows

alt: The Data Retention tab with Enable Automatic Data Retention switched on, the Retention Period dropdown and the Anonymization Status card
needs: data_retention_plugin granted to the firm (admin) and settings_json.data_retention.is_enabled true

alt: The Scheduled for Anonymization page listing candidates with Last Used, Scheduled For and Days Remaining columns and Keep Record buttons
needs: retention policy on with a short period, and a few candidates whose last reference activity is older than it (or within 30 days of it)

alt: The Single Sign-On tab in Configuration with the SSO Connections, SCIM Provisioning and Members sections
needs: firm has stytch_organization_id and the root recruiter is linked to a Stytch member with a live stytch_session_jwt cookie (Stytch test org)

alt: The Support Mode banner across the top of the app with the Viewing as email, the countdown and the Exit Support Mode button
needs: an active Support Mode (impersonation) session started from the admin app on the demo recruiter; the normal recruiter login won't show the banner

alt: A candidate's Feedback tab with the Feedback request button, the feedback surveys table and the employers table
needs: candidate feedback plugin on; candidate with at least one feedback request and one employer

alt: The Feedback request dialog with the Feedback type options and the Question set dropdown
needs: candidate and recruiter feedback plugins on (all three types listed); at least one question set of Type Feedback

alt: The Feedback page listing feedback requests with the date range picker, type filter and Everyone / Myself toggle
needs: feedback plugin on; several feedback requests of different types, some completed, inside the default date range

alt: The Feedback request dialog with Employer selected and the employer's name, phone and email fields
needs: candidate feedback plugin on; at least one question set of Type Feedback

alt: A candidate's Feedback tab showing a completed Employer feedback with its score, and the employers table below
needs: candidate with a completed Employer feedback (rating questions answered so a score shows) and its employer record
